scope: Review of failed-recovery active-pointer reconciliation, exclusive guard lifetime, focused regression tests, and the production caller error conversion.

branch_review.effect: Preserves candidate and sidecars; retains existing post-rename uncertainty behavior.
Uses the existing best-effort candidate/sidecar cleanup policy; active database is not changed.

branch_review.result: Indeterminate including both original recovery error and resolution error
branch_review.effect: No candidate, sidecar or pointer mutation; an unreadable or invalid pointer is not treated as proof that publication never occurred.

guard_lifetime.previous_finding: The prior inner async block moved the sole exclusive guard into its eventual successful store; an error could finish/drop that future before the outer reconciliation ran.
guard_lifetime.resolution: The outer scope now owns Arc<CognitiveStoreOpenGuard>. The inner future borrows that Arc and clones it only into a successful store. The outer match completes real reconciliation before an explicit drop(exclusive_guard).
guard_lifetime.error_path: The same underlying File-backed exclusive lock remains held through pointer resolution and any existing cleanup; no second lock or changed lock order is introduced.
guard_lifetime.success_path: The returned store retains an Arc clone of the same guard after the outer reference is dropped.
guard_lifetime.early_question_mark: Early errors after acquisition unwind the outer Arc normally; no forget, leaked reference or permanent extra ownership is introduced.
guard_lifetime.conclusion_basis: Static Rust ownership and scope analysis; the synchronous reconciliation interval was not dynamically probed.

caller_review.finding: CognitiveStore returns the typed Indeterminate error. Agentd converts its Display text to AgentdError::Protocol and returns via ?, before cloning a store or constructing the production writer. The path has no ordinary writable CognitiveStore::open fallback.

tests_reviewed.name: corrupt_active_pointer_preserves_candidate_and_pointer_bytes
tests_reviewed.finding: Creates a real private pointer with invalid content, verifies the specific Corrupt resolution error, and compares the full RecoveryTreeImage before/after reconciliation. Snapshot covers candidate, three sidecars, pointer bytes and captured metadata.

tests_reviewed.name: known_unpublished_candidate_is_removed_without_changing_active_database
tests_reviewed.finding: Verifies known-active original path, normal cleanup of the candidate and three sidecars, unchanged original bytes, absence of a newly created pointer, and preservation of the original error.

tests_reviewed.name: post_rename_publication_failure_is_indeterminate_and_retains_candidate
tests_reviewed.finding: Verifies the original active path before publication and requires the real active path to equal the candidate afterward. Only then may an actual late error or injected post-rename error exercise reconciliation; an earlier failure cannot satisfy the test.

tests_reviewed.name: predecessor_witness_is_rejected_and_current_witness_recovers
tests_reviewed.finding: Existing failed stale-cut recovery followed by valid-current recovery checks that an error does not permanently retain the recovery fence, when executed.

tests_reviewed.name: exact_current_cut_recovers_writable_generation_and_persists_activation
tests_reviewed.finding: Existing successful recovered writes and reopening after drop remain unchanged. It does not separately assert that a second open is blocked while the recovered store is live.

tests_reviewed.name: writable_recovery_requires_exclusive_store_fence
tests_reviewed.finding: Existing test requires recovery to be rejected while an ordinary store holds its shared fence; it is not an observation of the inner failure-cleanup interval.

primary_language_references.relevance: Async block capture modes are inferred from body usage; ? returns from the generated future.
Owned values and their fields are dropped on leaving their scopes.

limits: This is a static scoped approval, not a successful Rust build or native test run.
Windows ACL/private-owner qualification and general directory-durability equivalence are unchanged.
The old best-effort cleanup policy for a known different active database is retained; this patch does not redesign cleanup.
Final native CI must validate the registered source before claiming execution closure.
